item.title: Drones Add-On 1.1
item.creator: Maker Camp srls
item.description:
Discover Drones Add-On! Control and fly drones in ANY world!

+ 18 Controllable Drones with unique abilities
+ Custom utilities
+ Fight mobs or spy on your friends!

faqEntries.heading: How do I pick a drone back up?
faqEntries.content: Hit your own drone five times. You cannot hurt it, it just comes apart and drops itself, along with anything it was carrying. It keeps the battery level the drone had, so you can place it again later.

faqEntries.heading: How far can a drone fly from me?
faqEntries.content: Most drones stay within 64 blocks. The Race Drone goes up to 128 blocks, and the Spy Drone and Night Vision Drone up to 512. If you try to go further, the drone is pulled back toward you.

faqEntries.heading: My Drone Controller shows an empty list.
faqEntries.content: The controller only lists drones you placed yourself, and only those within 32 blocks. Move closer to your drones and try again.

faqEntries.heading: How do I tell the Item Collector or the Ore Finder what to look for?
faqEntries.content: Use the Drone Controller, select the drone, and pick the item or the ore from its menu.

howToEntries.content:
- Active Mode
You fly the drone yourself. The camera moves to the drone and your character stays where it is, so stand somewhere safe before you start. Move as you normally would to fly, jump to go up, sneak to go down, and look around to aim. Press Interact to use the drone ability, or hold it for drones like the Laser, Freeze, Mining and Mob Transporter. Change your hotbar slot to stop flying and go back to your body.

- Passive Mode
The drone follows you and works on its own. Combat drones shoot at nearby monsters, support drones grant you their effect. You can have up to 5 drones in Passive Mode at the same time.

- Standby Mode
The drone lands and waits for you. It uses no battery in this mode.
